about.title: Desert Hot Springs Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Four people died in traffic collisions in Desert Hot Springs during 2025, according to public records for this Riverside County city of roughly 28,000. Behind each number is a household now sorting through bills, paperwork and an empty chair. A wrongful death claim in California is a civil matter, entirely separate from any criminal case, and it exists so surviving family members can recover funeral and burial costs, the financial support the person would have provided, and the loss of their love, companionship and guidance. The corridors with the highest collision counts in public records are the ones residents drive every day: Palm Drive, Dillon Road, Pierson Boulevard and Hacienda Avenue. Not every wrongful death involves a vehicle, either; unsafe premises, defective products and medical errors can also form the basis of a claim. LawProactive is a free service, not a law firm. We listen to what happened and connect you with an independent attorney who handles wrongful death cases on contingency, meaning no fee unless there is a recovery.

items.title: Clarity on who can bring the claim
items.desc: California limits who may file: a spouse or domestic partner and children come first, followed by certain dependents and heirs. The attorney you're connected with can sort out standing before anything else.

items.title: Attention to the two-year deadline
items.desc: Most wrongful death actions must be filed within two years of the date of death, and the window is shorter when a government entity is involved. Getting connected early protects that timeline.

items.title: Losses that reflect the whole person
items.desc: Recoverable losses go beyond funeral and burial costs to include lost financial support and the loss of love, companionship and guidance. Your attorney works on contingency, so there is no fee unless there is a recovery.

items.question: My family member was killed in a crash on Dillon Road. Is a wrongful death claim the same as the criminal case?
items.answer: No. A wrongful death claim is a civil action brought by the family, while any criminal case is pursued by prosecutors in Riverside County. The two proceed separately, and a civil claim can move forward whether or not criminal charges are filed. An attorney can explain how the two may interact in your situation.

items.question: Who is allowed to file a wrongful death claim in California?
items.answer: Standing is limited under state law. The surviving spouse or domestic partner and the children have the first right to file, and if there are none, certain dependents and heirs may qualify. Because these rules can be confusing during an already painful time, the attorney you're connected with will review who in your family is eligible.

items.question: How long do we have to act after a death in Desert Hot Springs?
items.answer: In most cases the deadline is two years from the date of death. If a public agency is potentially responsible, such as a city or county vehicle or a road maintenance issue, the time to give notice is much shorter. Reaching out sooner rather than later helps keep every option open.
